landing_thesis.headline: OpenAI claims C and D. A and B remain open.
landing_thesis.body: Clay accepts a proof of any one of A, B, C or D. A/B are the unforced global-regularity statements; C/D allow smooth forcing and ask for breakdown. OpenAI published an analytic proof and Lean formalization claiming C/D. On 11 September CMI said the problem has "apparently been settled," while keeping its deliberately unhurried evaluation/credit process separate. Unforced A/B and much of Navier-Stokes remain open.
